At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions. 

We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences.

What's kept us moving?  The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward.

If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity. 

We can’t wait to get to know you! 


Purpose of the Job
The Corporate Secretary, reporting to the General Counsel, is the Bank’s senior governance officer and a trusted advisor to the Board of Directors, Board Chair, Committee Chairs, Chief Executive Officer and executive leadership. The role safeguards the integrity of EQB’s governance framework, enables effective Board decision-making and ensures EQB Inc., Equitable Bank and their subsidiaries meet applicable corporate, securities, stock exchange and financial institution governance obligations.

The Corporate Secretary leads the enterprise governance agenda, establishes governance standards, advises on complex Board and Committee matters and oversees corporate records, public-company reporting and insider compliance. The role ensures Board decisions are clearly documented, communicated and implemented, and operates with significant independence, discretion and judgment.
 

Board Leadership and Advisory: Act as principal governance advisor to the Board Chair, Committee Chairs, directors, the CEO and senior management on fiduciary duties, governance practices, conflicts of interest, decision authorities and Board processes.
 Lead the annual Board and Committee calendar, agendas and workplans, aligning regulatory obligations, strategic priorities, risk oversight and outstanding actions.
 Partner with the Board Chair, Committee Chairs, CEO and executive sponsors to ensure agendas and materials support informed, timely and effective decision-making.
 Oversee the timely and accurate assembly and distribution of board and committee materials for EQB and all subsidiaries
 Serve as Corporate Secretary at meetings of the Board, Board Committees and shareholders, ensuring meetings are properly called, constituted and conducted.
 Oversee preparation of accurate and defensible minutes and resolutions that reflect deliberations, challenge, conflicts, advice received, decisions and accountabilities while protecting confidentiality and legal privilege.
 Communicate Board decisions, assign accountabilities and oversee the timely completion of actions.
 Advise on director independence, suitability, succession, onboarding, education, evaluation, compensation, share ownership and departures.
 Lead Board, Committee, Chair and director effectiveness assessments and translate findings into practical governance improvements.
Corporate Governance and Regulatory Stewardship: Own and continuously strengthen EQB’s enterprise governance framework, including Board and Committee mandates, governance guidelines, position descriptions, by-laws, delegated authorities, policies and annual workplans.
 Monitor regulatory, legal, securities and governance developments affecting federally regulated financial institutions and Canadian public issuers.
 Assess emerging requirements and risks, provide clear recommendations and lead the implementation of required governance changes.
 Support the Board in fulfilling its oversight responsibilities in a manner aligned with EQB’s strategy, complexity and risk profile.
 Oversee subsidiary and affiliate governance, including entity records, appointments, mandates, meetings, approvals, registrations, licences and reporting.
 Lead director and officer conflict-of-interest, independence, related-party and personal compliance processes, escalating significant matters as required.
 Maintain effective relationships with regulators, securities authorities, stock exchanges, proxy advisors, external counsel, auditors and other governance stakeholders.
Public Company, Shareholder and Corporate Services: Lead the governance components of continuous disclosure and annual reporting, including the management information circular, annual information form, material change reports, voting results and governance-related website disclosure.
 Oversee accurate and timely SEDAR+ and SEDI filings, insider reporting and director and officer compliance with securities and stock exchange requirements.
 Lead the planning and execution of the annual meeting of shareholders, including proxy materials, voting, scripts, resolutions, meeting records and post-meeting filings.
 Oversee corporate and share capital documentation, including incorporations, continuances, director and officer changes, share issuances, transfers and redemptions, capital changes and dividend declarations.
 Manage relationships with the transfer agent, Toronto Stock Exchange, proxy solicitors, newswire providers and external advisors within the role’s mandate.
 Ensure the integrity, security, retention and accessibility of minute books, corporate records, Board materials and the Board portal.
Leadership and Operating Excellence: Lead the Board Services and corporate governance function, establishing clear priorities, standards, accountabilities, controls and service expectations.
 Translate enterprise priorities and governance requirements into functional strategies, workplans and measurable outcomes.
 Lead complex, cross-functional governance initiatives and establish clear responsibilities, timelines and escalation paths.
 Anticipate resource requirements, competing priorities and potential obstacles, and develop practical contingency plans.
 Modernize governance practices, processes and technology to improve Board effectiveness, information flow, security, efficiency and auditability.
 Build strong partnerships across Legal, Risk, Finance, Compliance, Internal Audit, Human Resources, Investor Relations and the business.
 Coach and mentor team members and emerging leaders, providing clear expectations, meaningful feedback and development opportunities.
 Manage the function’s budget, resources and external providers and report transparently on priorities, capacity, risks and delivery.
Let's Talk About You!: Undergraduate degree in law, business, governance or a related discipline. A Juris Doctor, Bachelor of Laws, governance designation or equivalent professional qualification is strongly preferred.
 15 or more years of progressive corporate governance, corporate secretarial, securities or legal experience, including significant experience supporting a Canadian public-company Board and its Committees.
 Significant experience within a federally regulated financial institution or another complex, highly regulated financial services organization.
 Expert knowledge of the Bank Act , Trust and Loan Companies Act , applicable corporate statutes, Canadian securities requirements, TSX requirements, OSFI governance expectations and leading Board practices.
 Demonstrated experience leading annual meeting and proxy processes, SEDAR+ and SEDI filings, insider reporting, subsidiary governance and corporate records.
 Recognized technical expertise in corporate governance, with the ability to anticipate regulatory and market developments and translate them into practical action.
 Exceptional Boardroom judgment, executive presence and credibility, with the confidence to provide independent advice and constructively challenge senior stakeholders.
 Strong analytical and business judgment, including the ability to assess complex issues, consider broader implications and make timely, risk-informed recommendations.
 Outstanding drafting and communication skills, including Board minutes, resolutions, mandates, policies, public disclosure and governance advice.
 Proven ability to navigate complex stakeholder relationships, build alignment and influence decisions across organizational boundaries.
 Demonstrated leadership of complex change initiatives, including the ability to anticipate resistance, create practical implementation plans and reinforce sustainable improvements.
 Strong planning, prioritization and resource management skills, with the ability to manage multiple long-term priorities and immovable deadlines.
 High integrity and discretion, with mature judgment in handling market-sensitive, privileged and confidential information.
Job Complexities and Thinking Challenges: The role operates at the intersection of the Board, senior management, regulators and public-company stakeholders. It requires the ability to interpret complex and evolving requirements, anticipate their broader implications and provide clear, practical advice in situations involving incomplete information, competing priorities or significant risk.
The Corporate Secretary must: 
 Exercise exceptional judgment in sensitive, uncertain and time-critical situations.
 Balance legal, regulatory, governance, strategic and stakeholder considerations.

Position Summary 
 As Product Owner for Sadie, you will be responsible for turning our product vision and roadmap into clearly defined, deliverable product outcomes.
 You will work closely with management, customers, engineering, design, and commercial teams to understand what needs to be built, define how it should work, and ensure it is delivered successfully.
 A major part of your role will be translating product ideas and customer problems into clear requirements, workflows, tickets, acceptance criteria, and expected behaviours that engineering can execute against.
 You will own the detail behind the roadmap and ensure what we ship fulfils the original product and customer intent.
 Values 
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills
 Strong ownership and accountability
 Customer-focused and outcome-driven
 Highly organized with strong attention to detail
 Comfortable challenging assumptions and asking questions
 Open to feedback and continuous improvement
 High degree of integrity, professionalism, and discretion
 What You’ll Be Doing 
 Work closely with management to translate the Sadie product vision and roadmap into actionable product initiatives.
 Own and maintain the product backlog, ensuring priorities are clearly defined and aligned with the roadmap.
 Break larger product initiatives into clear requirements, user stories, workflows, tickets, and acceptance criteria.
 Define exactly how Sadie should behave across different customer scenarios and edge cases.
 Ensure engineering has the context and requirements needed to build features correctly without ambiguity.
 Work closely with engineering throughout development to answer questions, resolve ambiguity, make trade-offs, and keep delivery aligned with the intended product outcome.
 Review and validate completed work against requirements and acceptance criteria before release.
 Test Sadie across real-world scenarios to ensure features and behaviours work as intended.
 Review real customer calls, feedback, and product usage to identify gaps, edge cases, and opportunities for improvement.
 Work with customers and internal teams to understand problems and translate feedback into actionable product requirements.
 Coordinate product pilots and releases, including defining scope, expected behaviour, success criteria, and feedback loops.
 Identify dependencies, blockers, risks, and missing requirements before they impact delivery.
 Maintain clear documentation around product functionality, decisions, requirements, and expected behaviour.
 Track progress against the roadmap and communicate product status, blockers, and changes to relevant stakeholders.
 Ensure features are not simply shipped, but actually fulfil the original product vision and solve the intended customer problem.
 Continuously improve how requirements are defined, communicated, tested, and delivered across the product organization.
 What You Bring 
 2+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar product-focused role.
 Experience working closely with software engineering teams to deliver customer-facing products.
 Strong ability to take a high-level product idea and turn it into detailed, actionable requirements.
 Experience writing clear product tickets, user stories, acceptance criteria, and functional requirements.
 Strong understanding of product workflows, user journeys, edge cases, and expected system behaviours.
 Experience managing and prioritizing a product backlog.
 Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify gaps or ambiguity before development begins.
 Ability to understand technical concepts sufficiently to communicate effectively with engineering teams.
 Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make pragmatic decisions when requirements or priorities change.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
 Ability to manage multiple initiatives and priorities in a fast-moving environment.
 Strong sense of ownership and accountability for the quality of the final product, not just the completion of tickets.
 Pluses 
 Experience working on conversational, voice, communications, or workflow products.
 Experience working with hospitality, restaurants, hotels, or other service-based businesses.
 Experience managing complex products with multiple integrations and dependencies.
 Experience working in a startup or fast-moving product environment.
 Comfortable working in an environment where the roadmap evolves quickly based on customer and business needs.
 Am I Right for This Position? 
 You will be a strong fit if you enjoy taking an idea that may initially be high-level or ambiguous and turning it into something an engineering team can confidently build.
 You should naturally think about questions like:
 What exactly should happen? What happens if something goes wrong? What are the edge cases? What does success look like? Does what we built actually match what we intended?
 You do not need to be an engineer. You do need to be comfortable working closely with engineers and taking ownership of the detail required to turn a product vision into a working product.
 Why Is This Job Important? 
 Sadie is evolving quickly, and our ability to execute on our product vision depends on turning ideas and customer needs into clear, well-defined work for our engineering teams.
 The Product Owner sits between vision and execution.
 Your responsibility is to make sure the roadmap does not remain a collection of ideas. It becomes clearly defined functionality that engineering can build, customers can use, and the business can measure.
 What Will I Learn in This Position? 
 You will gain hands-on experience building and scaling a rapidly evolving technology product used in real customer interactions every day.
 You will work closely with leadership, engineering, customers, and commercial teams and develop a deep understanding of how product strategy is translated into requirements, delivered through engineering, validated with customers, and continuously improved.

 Tester Sadie dans des scénarios réels afin de s’assurer que les fonctionnalités et les comportements fonctionnent comme prévu.
 Analyser de véritables appels clients, la rétroaction reçue et l’utilisation du produit afin de cerner les lacunes, les cas limites et les occasions d’amélioration.
 Travailler avec les clients et les équipes internes pour comprendre les problèmes et traduire la rétroaction en exigences produit concrètes.
 Coordonner les projets pilotes et les mises en production, y compris la définition de la portée, des comportements attendus, des critères de succès et des boucles de rétroaction.
 Cerner les dépendances, les blocages, les risques et les exigences manquantes avant qu’ils n’affectent la livraison.
 Maintenir une documentation claire sur les fonctionnalités du produit, les décisions prises, les exigences et les comportements attendus.
 Suivre l’avancement par rapport à la roadmap et communiquer l’état du produit, les blocages et les changements aux parties prenantes concernées.
 Veiller à ce que les fonctionnalités ne soient pas simplement livrées, mais qu’elles réalisent réellement la vision produit initiale et résolvent le problème client visé.
 Améliorer continuellement la façon dont les exigences sont définies, communiquées, testées et livrées au sein de l’organisation produit.

 Grande capacité à transformer une idée produit de haut niveau en exigences détaillées et concrètes.
 Expérience de la rédaction de tickets produit, de user stories, de critères d’acceptation et d’exigences fonctionnelles clairs.
 Bonne compréhension des workflows produit, des parcours utilisateurs, des cas limites et des comportements système attendus.
 Expérience de la gestion et de la priorisation d’un backlog produit.
 Grand souci du détail et capacité à repérer les lacunes ou les ambiguïtés avant le début du développement.
 Capacité à comprendre suffisamment les concepts techniques pour communiquer efficacement avec les équipes d’ingénierie.
 Solides aptitudes en résolution de problèmes et capacité à prendre des décisions pragmatiques lorsque les exigences ou les priorités changent.
 Excellentes aptitudes en communication écrite et verbale.
 Capacité à gérer plusieurs initiatives et priorités dans un environnement en évolution rapide.
 Fort sens de la prise en charge et de l’imputabilité quant à la qualité du produit final, et non seulement quant à la fermeture des tickets.
 Atouts 
 Expérience avec des produits conversationnels, vocaux, de communication ou de workflow.
 Expérience auprès d’entreprises du secteur de l’hôtellerie, de la restauration ou d’autres entreprises de services.
 Expérience de la gestion de produits complexes comportant de multiples intégrations et dépendances.
 Expérience au sein d’une entreprise en démarrage (startup) ou dans un environnement produit en évolution rapide.

 Vous n’avez pas besoin d’être ingénieur. Vous devez toutefois être à l’aise de travailler en étroite collaboration avec des ingénieurs et de prendre en charge le niveau de détail nécessaire pour transformer une vision produit en produit fonctionnel.

 Vous acquerrez une expérience pratique de la conception et de la mise à l’échelle d’un produit technologique en évolution rapide, utilisé chaque jour dans de véritables interactions avec les clients.

 Analyze paid media performance across LinkedIn, Google, and programmatic, not just reporting on it, but forming a view on where the budget should move and why.
 Use AI tools to automate the analytics work that doesn't require judgment: lead enrichment, anomaly detection, routine reporting, intent signal processing. The point is to free up time for the work that does require judgment.
 Identify and fix process gaps in the funnel, lead routing errors, lifecycle stage inconsistencies, data hygiene issues, working with RevOps and the HubSpot admin to close them properly.
 Partner with campaign and demand generation leads at the start of each program to set measurement frameworks, then come back at the end with a retrospective that's genuinely useful for the next campaign.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!




ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a design engineer to help build and maintain Waypoint, our design system, across both the Figma library and the production codebase. This is not a "designer who codes a little" or an "engineer who dabbles in Figma" role. You should be genuinely fluent on both sides, comfortable defining a component's behavior and states in Figma one hour and shipping the same component to npm the next.

You'll take direct ownership of the Figma side of our library (structure, variants, tokens, documentation) while also contributing to the core Waypoint system: our component packages, our token pipeline, and the tooling that keeps design and code in sync. If the idea of being the single point of continuity between a Figma frame and a production component sounds exciting rather than exhausting, this is your role.

We're also thinking beyond the system we have today. Waypoint isn't just meant to serve designers and engineers, it's meant to become something a model can read, reason about, and build with directly. We want someone who can help us get there: grounded enough to do the unglamorous work of making today's system solid, and forward looking enough to help define what an intelligent design system looks like next.




WHY THIS ROLE



Waypoint is still early enough that the decisions you make now will shape how the system scales. You'll have real ownership, not just a queue of component tickets, and you'll be working alongside a team that treats design and engineering as one discipline rather than two departments that hand work back and forth. And you'll be helping define what a design system becomes when it has to serve a third audience: the models that will increasingly build with it.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own and evolve the Figma library for Waypoint: component structure, variants, properties, and documentation, so it stays a reliable source of truth for design teams.

 - Build and maintain core Waypoint components, contributing directly to our component packages alongside the design engineering team.

 - Work across our token pipeline, keeping design tokens in Figma and their code representations (CSS custom properties, Tailwind config) tightly synced.

 - Partner with product designers to translate new patterns into system components, and with product engineers to make sure those components are easy to adopt correctly.

 - Help define and refine the workflows and tooling that connect Figma and code (sync scripts, plugins, documentation sites) rather than relying on manual handoff.

 - Write clear documentation and usage guidance so the system scales without you being the bottleneck.

 - Weigh in on system architecture decisions: when to add a new component versus extend an existing one, how to version and package changes, how to keep the system consistent as it grows.

 - Help shape how Waypoint evolves to serve a third consumer beyond designers and engineers: the model itself. That means thinking about how components, tokens, and patterns get structured so they're legible to AI systems, not just to humans.

ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.


ABOUT THE RETAIL TEAM

 - Sierra is partnering with a large and growing number of retailers - spanning apparel and beauty, grocery and big-box, home and auto, consumer services, marketplaces, and consumer technology. Our agents help millions of shoppers and members every day: tracking and returning orders, finding the right product, booking services, and resolving issues in each brand’s own voice.

 - Retail is also where AI agents go beyond support to generate revenue. From product discovery and personalized recommendations to cart recovery, win-back campaigns, and in-store support that turns unanswered store calls into visits and sales, our team is redefining what an agent can do for a brand’s top line - not just its cost line.

 - Join us to transform how the world’s most-loved consumer brands engage their customers - and help build technology that makes shopping more personal, effortless, and delightful for everyone.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Be the primary partner to your Sales counterparts helping to win deals and grow customers

 - Go from first discovery to a tailored, working agent in days, not weeks, across prospects and existing customers

 - Work with every team involved in the decision: CX, IT, security, procurement, and executive sponsors

 - Own the end-to-end technical pre-sales process by scoping customer use cases, articulating business value, designing and demoing Sierra’s incredible platform, leading technical and architecture reviews, and serving as the trusted technical expert throughout the sales cycle

 - Mentor newer SEs and contribute reusable assets for your industry or team

 - Stay with the account after the sale, through the Agent Development handoff, launch, and expansion to new use cases

 - Go deep on your industry, the patterns, and winning motions to scale your work


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 4-6+ years experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering or customer-facing technical sales

 - Experience in leading the sales process with large Enterprise customers with deal sizes ranging $500-$1M

 - Past experience in demo building, and presenting, and working with customers or clients in the GTM function

 - Experience in relationship-building with prospects, including executives and technical leaders

 - Ability to connect a prospect’s specific business problems and Sierra’s solutions and explain them to both a technical and non-technical audience

 - Ability to leverage AI tools efficiently as a regular part of your technical sales motion — discovery prep, solution design, demo and prototype building, technical proposals. Importantly, you own the accuracy of anything you put in front of a customer, whether or not AI helped you build it

 - Experience growing accounts past initial sale

 - Bachelor's Degree or above; bonus if in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience


EVEN BETTER...

 - Experience translating code, technical logic and user requirements to product and engineering requirements

 - Selling a technical AI product


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world.  An overview of this role 
 As a Fullstack Engineer on the Duo Client SDK team at GitLab, you'll build the shared foundation for every GitLab Duo client. Today, the logic that powers Duo in editors lives inside the GitLab Language Server. We're extracting it into a true software development kit (SDK): a set of well-versioned TypeScript packages that editor extensions, our web-based Duo Chat on GitLab.com, and eventually external applications can use.
 You'll work in TypeScript across frontend and backend systems. You'll design the SDK's Node.js core and public application programming interface (API), and work in the clients that use it. The work rewards care about interfaces, versioning, and backward compatibility as much as features because other engineers will depend on what you build.
 You'll have senior and staff engineers alongside you to help with design. You'll own the implementation of scoped packages and ship improvements with minimal guidance while collaborating with the team on larger architectural changes.
 Some examples of our projects:
 The Duo Client SDK, extracting versioned, publishable packages from the GitLab Language Server
 The GitLab Language Server, rebuilt on top of the SDK as our polyglot surface
 Duo Chat on the web, as one of the SDK's first consumers
 What you'll do 
 Develop secure, well-tested, and performant TypeScript features that solve technical problems of moderate scope and complexity.
 Ship small features and improvements with minimal guidance, writing tests with every merge request and contributing to code reviews and design discussions.
 Extract and publish TypeScript packages from the GitLab Language Server, migrating consumers incrementally so no parallel implementation is left to drift.
 Design durable public APIs with clear interfaces, semantic versioning, changelogs, and deprecation paths for external consumers.
 Build isomorphic core packages that isolate platform-specific behavior in adapters at the edges.
 Build and improve SDK client surfaces, including Vue 3 components in Duo Chat on the web, in collaboration with product, design, and engineering teams.
 Strengthen credential handling across hosts, including bearer tokens, session cookies, and CSRF protection.
 Optimize bundle size, startup cost, and dependency weight for browser consumers, and support a Tier 2 on-call rotation for urgent engineering issues.
 What you'll bring 
 Strong proficiency with TypeScript across frontend and backend systems, including experience building and maintaining Node.js services.
 Experience with modern build and packaging tools, including monorepos, multi-module builds, ECMAScript modules (ESM), and dependency management.
 Experience with Vue 3 and the Composition API, or comparable component-based frontend experience and a willingness to learn Vue.
 Experience designing APIs that other people use, with the ability to explain what you'd do differently.
 Understanding of the differences between running code in Node.js and in the browser, and how to write code that works in both.
 A security-minded development approach, including careful credential handling and performance optimization.
 Ability to communicate clearly and concisely in writing about technical problems, propose iterative solutions, and work effectively in an agile environment.
 Self-motivation, strong organizational skills, and the judgment to ask for help when needed while thriving in a fully remote organization aligned with GitLab's values.

 Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) directeur/directrice d’unité, Assurance des entreprises B&A - Petite entreprises. pour se joindre à notre équipe.

 Collaborer à l’élaboration et à l’exécution des stratégies du secteur et de la succursale.
 Établir les priorités relatives aux relations avec les courtiers en fonction des résultats, des occasions d’affaires et des objectifs stratégiques.
 Favoriser une croissance rentable tout en maintenant l’excellence des pratiques de souscription.

ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands — including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank — to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.


ABOUT THE CONSUMER BUSINESS SERVICES TEAM

 - Sierra partners with the businesses that power everyday life for consumers and enterprises alike — from the CPG brands on every shelf to the logistics networks that get products there, the real estate and facilities teams that manage the buildings people live and work in, and the energy and utility providers that keep the lights on. Our agents handle everything from order tracking and account management to field service scheduling and billing support, tuned to the voice and workflows of each business.

 - This vertical spans a wide range of industries — consumer products, commercial real estate, automotive & mobility, transportation & logistics, industrial manufacturing, information & data services, consumer electronics, professional services, facilities management, construction, energy, and utilities — giving you the breadth to build relationships across some of the largest and most established companies in the world.

 - Join us to bring AI agents to the businesses that quietly run the economy — and help build technology that makes these essential services faster, more reliable, and more human for everyone who depends on them.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Be the primary partner to your Sales counterparts helping to win deals and grow customers

 - Go from first discovery to a tailored, working agent in days, not weeks, across prospects and existing customers

 - Work with every team involved in the decision: CX, IT, security, procurement, and executive sponsors

 - Own the end-to-end technical pre-sales process by scoping customer use cases, articulating business value, designing and demoing Sierra’s incredible platform, leading technical and architecture reviews, and serving as the trusted technical expert throughout the sales cycle

 - Mentor newer SEs and contribute reusable assets for your industry or team

 - Stay with the account after the sale, through the Agent Development handoff, launch, and expansion to new use cases

 - Go deep on your industry, the patterns, and winning motions to scale your work


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 4-6+ years experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering or customer-facing technical sales

 - Experience in leading the sales process with large Enterprise customers with deal sizes ranging $500-$1M

 - Past experience in demo building, and presenting, and working with customers or clients in the GTM function

 - Experience in relationship-building with prospects, including executives and technical leaders

 - Ability to connect a prospect’s specific business problems and Sierra’s solutions and explain them to both a technical and non-technical audience

 - Ability to leverage AI tools efficiently as a regular part of your technical sales motion — discovery prep, solution design, demo and prototype building, technical proposals. Importantly, you own the accuracy of anything you put in front of a customer, whether or not AI helped you build it

 - Experience growing accounts past initial sale

 - Bachelor's Degree or above; bonus if in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent professional experience


EVEN BETTER...

 - Experience translating code, technical logic and user requirements to product and engineering requirements

 - Selling a technical AI product


OUR VALUES

 - Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

 - Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

 - Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

 - Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

 - Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions and processes. We are the best technology company for parents. We support and respect each other and celebrate each other’s personal and professional achievements.


WHAT WE OFFER

We want our benefits to reflect our values and offer the following to full-time employees:

 - Flexible (unlimited) paid time off

 - Medical, dental, and vision benefits for you and your family

 - Life insurance and disability benefits

 - Retirement plan dependent on country of employment

 - Parental leave

 - Fertility and family building benefits through Carrot

 - Lunch, as well as delicious snacks and coffee to keep you energized 

 - Discretionary benefit stipend giving people the ability to spend where it matters most

 - Free alphorn lessons

These benefits are further detailed in Sierra's policies, may vary by region, and are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation or benefits plans. Eligible full-time employees can participate in Sierra's equity plans subject to the terms of the applicable plans and policies.


BE YOU, WITH US

We're working to bring the transformative power of AI to every organization in the world.
